title: UAAP: Galsim's Olimpico salvages draw for UP in Finals rematch vs. FEU
summary: Far Eastern University and University of the Philippines battled to an entertaining 2-2 draw in the UAAP Season 89 men's football tournament, Sunday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
